groups.inclusive_effect: Cairo is added as a weak proxy.

groups.topic: Tripoli and Tortosa as a county core

rule: A baseline seed requires a reviewed locality-control claim. Political centers, events, routes, and territorial extent are recorded separately and cannot be promoted by defaults.
